records.title: FOUR LANNING OF DESHGAON TO BARWANI ROAD.
details:
a to c: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has taken up Detailed Project Report (DPR) preparation for development of Deshgaon to Julwania section of National Highway (NH) No. 347B to four-lanes NH standards. The decision on the project would be by the Government based on outcome of DPR and inter-se-priority.
347B, the DPR for two-laning with paved shoulders based on present traffic requirement is finalized and the work be sanctioned by the Government based on inter-se-priority and overall availability of funds.
